source_boundary.evidence_tier: local source-faithful callback microcourt; not product wall/RSS

cpu_microcourt.operation: successful per-recipe callback ownership only; SHA/hint/Deflate bookkeeping plus overlay commit
cpu_microcourt.interpretation: Python callback bookkeeping overhead stays sub-millisecond even at 1024 members in this isolated court; full product timing still required because ZIP parsing/decompression, encoding, dictionary work and allocator behavior are outside this measurement.

memory_microcourt.shape: 1000 already-owned unique 64KiB raw candidates replayed as fresh duplicate byte objects
memory_microcourt.decision: Reuse live Candidate.raw and already-owned exact Deflate stream objects in the overlay; stage only delta metadata/counts for existing hashes.

ordering_microcourt.property: candidate insertion order and per-candidate exact-Deflate insertion order match direct successful callback semantics

sequential_episode_microcourt.property: transactional state equals ideal state where only successful recipes commit

decision: No lower-rung carrying-cost veto found. Advance the refined live-object-reusing transactional overlay to focused product implementation/tests, then measure complete same-source bytes/tree/wall/RSS.
